sop_modules.name: New Drywall Wall Preparation
sop_modules.description: Prepare new drywall wall surfaces for primer application. Includes inspection and dust removal. NO spot-priming of fasteners — new drywall fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant (RC-001).

tasks.name: Inspect Wall Surface
tasks.description: Walk all wall surfaces with work light angled to reveal defects: fastener pops, unfilled joints, damaged paper, ridges, or debris. Raking light angle reveals defects that direct light hides.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 uses quick walk-through in ambient light, no raking light required. Only flag major obvious defects (holes, unfilled joints, fastener pops). Rate is faster than QT3 due to reduced scrutiny.

quality_notes.QT2: Note only major defects (fastener pops, holes)
quality_notes.QT3: Identify and mark all visible defects including minor ridges
quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright raking light, mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Inspect Wall Surface (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all wall surfaces using work light at raking angle. Mark all imperfections including minor ridges, scratches, and texture inconsistencies. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright raking light, mark all imperfections for correction

tasks.name: Vacuum Wall Drywall Dust
tasks.description: Remove drywall dust from wall surfaces using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment. Work top to bottom systematically.
tasks.qt2_notes: Binary task - dust removal is performed at all tiers. Cannot be skipped at QT2 because dust compromises primer adhesion. QT2 may use quicker pass but task is still required.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick pass to remove loose dust
quality_notes.QT3: Thorough vacuum of all wall surfaces
quality_notes.QT4: Complete vacuum with attention to corners and edges

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Vacuum. Inspection identifies issues, vacuum removes dust before priming. NO spot-priming of fasteners — new drywall fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant (RC-001).

sop_modules.name: Floor Protection for Wall Spray
sop_modules.description: Set up full-room floor protection before wall spray work. Wall overspray falls to floor — full coverage required.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Full Room)
tasks.description: Install full-room floor protection. Hard floors: rosin paper with taped seams and perimeter tape. Carpet: 1.5 mil plastic with taped edges. Full coverage required for spray work.

site_condition_rules.affects: Protection material selection: rosin paper for hard floors, plastic for carpet. Subfloor may not require protection (RC-003).

quality_notes.all: Full room coverage, all seams taped, no gaps

tasks.name: Floor Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove floor protection after wall priming is complete. Fold toward center to contain debris.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Setup before any spray work. Teardown after all wall spray/backroll complete. In NC sequence, floor protection may stay for subsequent phases.

sop_modules.name: Floor Protection for Wall Roll
sop_modules.description: Set up perimeter floor protection for wall rolling. Roll method has minimal drip risk — perimeter drops sufficient.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Perimeter)
tasks.description: Install perimeter floor protection using drop cloths. Position drops under work areas to catch drips from cut-in and roller work.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Teardown (Perimeter)
tasks.description: Remove drop cloths after wall priming is complete.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Setup before rolling work. Teardown after complete.

sop_modules.name: Fixture Protection for Wall Spray
sop_modules.description: Cover electrical outlets, switches, and installed fixtures to protect from wall spray overspray.

tasks.name: Cover Fixtures for Spray
tasks.description: Apply covers to electrical outlets, switches, and any installed fixtures. Estimate ~6 outlets/switches per room average.

quality_notes.all: All exposed electrical and fixture openings covered

tasks.name: Remove Fixture Covers
tasks.description: Remove fixture covers after wall spray is complete.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Setup before spray work. Teardown after spray complete.

sop_modules.name: Apply Wall Primer - Roller Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer coat to wall using roller. Includes cut-in at ceiling line.

tasks.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge
tasks.description: Brush-cut primer along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Cut line should be clean and extend 2-3 inches down wall for roller overlap. Required for roll method regardless of ceiling state.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 prioritizes coverage over line quality. Minor edge wobble is acceptable as long as coverage is complete. Rate is faster than QT3 due to relaxed precision standard.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks, straight line

tasks.important_note: We do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. We cut in at the ceiling line. Only millwork ceilings would require masking.

tasks.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality brush-cut primer along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Crisp, straight line with no brush marks. QT4 requires meticulous edge work.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks, perfectly straight line

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Wall
tasks.description: Apply primer to wall field using 9-inch roller. Work in W pattern, maintain wet edge, avoid lap marks.
tasks.qt2_notes: Binary task - application quality is identical at all tiers. Drips, sags, holidays fail at QT2 just as at QT3. No reduction in application standards.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Surface must be uniformly sealed.

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Wall (Textured Surface)
tasks.description: Apply primer to textured wall surfaces using 1/2-inch nap roller. 1/2-inch nap works primer into texture valleys while avoiding excessive stipple. Maintain wet edge.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. All texture valleys must be filled and sealed.

tasks.important_note: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for knockdown — 3/4" is only for stomp/popcorn or porous masonry.

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Wall (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality primer application for QT4 finish. Uniform mil thickness, no visible lap marks, consistent sheen across all wall surfaces.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.
quality_notes.QT4: Additional: verify uniform mil thickness and consistent sheen

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in first, then roll. Maintain wet edge between cut-in and roll to avoid lap marks.

sop_modules.name: Apply Wall Primer - Spray + Backroll Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer to wall via airless spray followed by backroll for consolidation and sealing. Backroll is MANDATORY for primer on bare drywall to consolidate primer into pores. When ceiling is already primed, spray directly into wall-to-ceiling corner — no cut-in needed.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Wall
tasks.description: Apply primer via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Work systematically. When ceiling is already primed, spray directly into wall-to-ceiling corner — no cut-in or ceiling masking needed.
tasks.qt2_notes: Binary task - spray application quality is identical at all tiers. Drips, sags, holidays fail at QT2 just as at QT3. No reduction in application standards.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.important_note: When ceiling is primed, spray primer directly into wall-to-ceiling corner. Do NOT mask drywall ceilings.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Wall (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality wall spray primer application. Uniform coverage, consistent mil thickness, no drips or sags. Slower pace with meticulous overlap control.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer
tasks.description: Immediately follow spray with roller to consolidate primer into drywall surface. Use 18-inch roller on extension pole when possible; 9-inch acceptable in tight spaces. Critical for eliminating air pockets and ensuring proper sealing of bare drywall.
tasks.qt2_notes: Binary task - backroll application quality is identical at all tiers. Drips, sags, holidays fail at QT2 just as at QT3. Consolidation into drywall is required at all tiers.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Primer must be fully consolidated into surface.

tasks.important_note: Backroll is MANDATORY for primer on bare drywall. Spray-only is NEVER valid. 18-inch roller typical; 9-inch acceptable when obstacles prevent 18-inch.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer (Textured Surface)
tasks.description: Backroll sprayed primer into textured wall surface using 1/2-inch nap roller. Work primer into all texture valleys.

quality_notes.all: No application defects. All texture valleys must have primer fully consolidated.

tasks.important_note: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown. Do NOT use 3/4" nap.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality wall backroll for QT4 finish. Thorough consolidation, no stipple, uniform sheen. Multiple passes if needed.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Primer must be fully consolidated into surface.
quality_notes.QT4: Additional: verify uniform sheen, no stipple

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray → Backroll (immediately). Backroller must follow sprayer closely — spray rate cannot exceed backroll rate. No ceiling masking or cut-in needed when ceiling is primed.

sop_modules.name: Wall Prime Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Clean tools, inspect wall prime work. NOTE: We do not mask drywall ceilings so there is no ceiling masking to remove.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Store or dispose properly.

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all primed wall surfaces. Check for holidays, missed spots, drips, or edge issues. Use raking light for inspection. Touch up as needed.
tasks.qt2_notes: QT2 is quick visual scan for major misses only. Ambient light, no raking light required. Rate is faster than QT3 due to reduced scrutiny. Still catches drips, sags, and holidays.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick visual check for major misses
quality_notes.QT3: Walk all surfaces with raking light, touch up as needed
quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under raking light, touch up any visible defects

tasks.name: Vacuum Floor After Prime
tasks.description: Vacuum floor area to remove dust and debris from priming phase.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Clean tools while primer is wet. Final inspect, vacuum cleanup.

round_configurations.name: Single Wall Prime Round
round_configurations.description: Standard single coat of primer for new drywall wall.
round_configurations.notes: Single primer coat is standard for new drywall wall with topcoat to follow.

round_configurations.name: Wall Prime (Premium)
round_configurations.description: Premium primer application for QT4 wall finish.
round_configurations.notes: Light sand of primed surface is prep phase of SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH, not part of prime spec.

critical_constraints.spray_only_prohibited: Spray-only is NEVER valid for priming bare drywall. Backroll is MANDATORY to consolidate primer into drywall pores. Without backroll, even sheen on finish coats is impossible.
critical_constraints.no_ceiling_masking: We do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. We either cut in at the ceiling line (roll method) or spray directly into the corner (spray+backroll). Only millwork ceilings would require masking.
critical_constraints.roller_nap_textured: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown textures. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for knockdown — 3/4" is only for stomp/popcorn or porous masonry.
